sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The purpose of the works is to meet demand for nature-based and domestic tourism, increase participation in visitor activities to national parks and align with the vision to inspire everyone to enjoy and engage with national parks. Project goals include:
- Create an inspiring nature-based experience hub highlighting the Great Eastern Escarpment and the significance of the World Heritage areas, listed rainforests and old-growth hardwood forests within Dorrigo NP.
- Protect, respect and promote the park’s environmental and cultural heritage.
- Create high-quality nature-based experiences and educational opportunities that grow awareness of Australia’s ancient Gondwana rainforests and foster future conservation advocacy and stewardship opportunities.
- Generate economic benefit for the local community and sustainable growth of the regional economy.
- Provide opportunities for Aboriginal communities to rightfully share their culture, participate in and benefit from the regional visitor economy.
- Create experiences for nature-based tourism, with well-designed, efficient facilities and infrastructure to manage visitation.
- Support visitation by a diverse cross-section of the community and offer a range of experiences to enhance accessibility.
- Provide opportunities to generate revenue that supports NPWS programs and operations, including enabling reinvestment in local conservation, restoration and education initiatives.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Dorrigo ARC Skywalk design and construction project includes:
- Design of the elevated Arc walkway and new Southern Ramp, including investigation works / reports, completed design package and any required non-Principal supplied permits and approvals to commence construction activities.
- Demolishing the existing Dorrigo Rainforest skywalk lookout and Southern declining ramp.
- Construction of the elevated Arc walkway and walking ramp to the rainforest floor and the Wonga walk, including civil, structural, architectural and other discipline works.
- Construction and commissioning deliverables, including testing, commissioning, and verification
- Project handover documentation.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
Pre-Tender Meetings
- Online - A mandatory online pre-tender meeting via Microsoft Teams is scheduled for:
  - Monday 24/08/2026
  - 1:00pm - 3:00pm
You must register your attendance with the RFT Contact Person at least 3 business days prior to the online pre-tender meeting to receive the meeting details.
- On-site - A mandatory on-site pre-tender meeting will also be held. Details of the on-site meeting will be provided at the online pre-tender meeting.
Supplier Account
You must have a Supplier account on Supplier Hub to lodge a response. To create a Supplier account go to https://buy.nsw.gov.au/login/signup.
Notifications
To receive notifications (addenda etc.), suppliers must either save this opportunity to their dashboard or start a draft response.
Lodging a Response
You must lodge your tender via the buy NSW Tenders platform. You must not submit your tender via email. Late submissionscannot be accepted, so we suggest uploading your submission earlier in the day, as you may experience delays and disallowed files. Click the RESPOND button to submit your tender response. Responses must be submitted into the buy NSW system before 3pm on the close date. Responses can be submitted and edited multiple times until the opportunity closes, with only the most recent submission being submitted.
buy NSW Tenders Help
If you experience technical difficulties submitting your tender, contact the buy NSW team at buy.nsw@customerservice.nsw.gov.au or 1800 679 289.

Tender Response Schedules
This RFT process is being managed under the Two-Envelope system. The Tender must be lodged in two clearly identified packages, “Envelope 1: Non-price information” and “Envelope 2: Price information”.
The first package is for Tender Schedules and other documents containing information responding to non-price Tender evaluation criteria and must not include any price information.
The second package is for the Tender Form and any other Tender Schedules containing price information.
Please download and complete the attached tender schedules. Once completed, save and upload your response. You can keep editing your response until 3pm of the closing date.
